diagnostic.help: share places that exist and accept the same colors
diagnostic.message: share take.(lock) ~ worker.(start): worker.(start) accepts job, but take.(lock) accepts key

source.text:
composition pair_colors
use "take.petrinet" as take
use "give.petrinet" as give
use "worker.petrinet" as worker
wire take.(busy) -> give.(busy)
share take.(lock) ~ worker.(start)
